page: Amazon Web Services r7a.metal-48xl is a bare-metal, memory-optimized server powered by AMD EPYC 9R14 processors. It features 192 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture with a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPUs, and relies on a 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark data shows top-tier multi-core CPU and memory performance. The server achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Passmark CPU scores, and Geekbench multi-core metrics. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, scoring in the top tier for both cached small-block and uncached large-block read and write operations. It also demonstrates top-tier performance in Redis SET operations, processing 332.38 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput at 115.69 GB/sec.

While prompt processing for large language models ranges from strong to top-tier, text generation speeds for smaller models fall into the bottom 25%, indicating a potential bottleneck in sequential text generation tasks without GPU acceleration. The lack of local storage requires external storage solutions. This server is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale database operations, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
